title: Chapter 138 Deserted City Jiangbei
content:
Chapter 138 Deserted City Jiangbei

Thinking of this, Lu Xue was eager to move.

"Mom, I want to go back and take a look."

Lu Xue found Yan Lingyun and said directly.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun was slightly stunned, "Xiaoxue, is it not good here for mom?"

Yan Lingyun looked at Lu Xue with some worry.

She thought that it was not good here for her, and Lu Xue could not stay, so she wanted to go back to the deserted city.

But obviously, Yan Lingyun thought too much.

I saw Lu Xue shook her head and said, "No, mom, I just want to go back and take a look. After all, dad is gone, and I am afraid that something will happen in the deserted city."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun was relieved.

"Is that so? Well, do you need mom to go back with you?"

"No, mom, I can go back by myself."

At this time, Ao Qing said faintly: "My lady, there is still me."

"You, you are not a human being."

.........

Then, Lu Xue and Ao Qing set out on the road back to the deserted city together.

At the same time, a figure appeared at the border between the Divine Dynasty and the Divine Star Domain.

Looking at the special restriction in front of him, he did not hesitate at all, just punched out simply.

Suddenly, the terrifying power poured out.

Boom!

The explosion sounded, and the entire border began to fall apart.

"How dare you!"

The next moment, a roar sounded.

A middle-aged man in silver armor appeared in the field.

The powerful aura of the God Emperor Realm continued to flow out of his body.

"You trespassed into the God Star Domain, don't you want to live?"

Looking at the figure in front of him, the middle-aged man said coldly.

Hearing this, the figure smiled lightly and said, "Don't mind, I just want to see if there is anyone here who can defeat me."

As soon as these words came out, the middle-aged man was stunned.

So arrogant?

"Hehe, hehe, are you serious?"

The middle-aged man laughed in anger, where did this come from?

However, the next moment, his smile solidified.

I saw that the man not far in front of him had passed him and headed for the depths of the Zhishen Star Domain.

Seeing this scene, the middle-aged man said in a serious tone: "Looking for death!"

Swish!

Suddenly, the middle-aged man rushed directly towards the figure, and the aura of the peak of the Divine Emperor Realm was clearly visible.

Facing the full-strength attack of the middle-aged man, the man's expression did not change at all, but turned around and punched out lightly.

"What!"

A strong man in the super-god realm!

At the last moment, a strong regret surged in the middle-aged man's eyes.

This guy is actually a martial god!

Boom!

Accompanied by a muffled sound.

The middle-aged man lost consciousness directly and lay flat in the void.

The other party held back.

In the Divine Dynasty.

Several powerful auras suddenly began to tremble, and the terrifying consciousness immediately went to the border.

The aura of the Martial God!

Who is it?

At this time, a figure with a deep aura was seen stepping on the void and walking slowly towards here.

Jiangbei!

Since leaving the deserted city, Jiangbei has been looking for a strong opponent.

However, until now, Jiangbei has not met one, and there is not even one who can take his three moves.

Alas, for a while, I fell into such a situation where I have no opponent again.

Without an opponent, how can I go further?

Buzz——

Just then, the space in front of Jiangbei suddenly cracked.

The next moment, a man in a black robe slowly stepped out of the crack.

"Martial God?"

The black-robed man whispered.

Jiangbei nodded, "Please teach me."

"I'd love to."

The two hit it off, and suddenly, the two super-god auras collided with each other.

In an instant, the entire void began to shatter.

In the Divine Dynasty, countless practitioners looked at the two confronting figures in the void in horror.

Is this the real top powerhouse?

It was so terrifying.

"Who is the one in black?"

Someone looked at the two people above and asked a question.

"That's the commander of the Imperial Guard of the Divine Dynasty, Lord Qin."

At this time, someone answered.

Hearing this, everyone was shocked.

It turned out to be the commander of the Imperial Guard of the Divine Dynasty. To be honest, they had never seen the commander of the Imperial Guard take action.

After all, the responsibility of the Imperial Guard is to protect the safety of the Imperial Capital.

But looking at the entire known star field, no one or force has ever been able to attack their Divine Dynasty Imperial Capital.

But now there is.

And the one who came is a super-god-level martial god!

Looking at Jiang Bei who was confronting the commander of the Imperial Guard of the Divine Dynasty, many masters in the Divine Dynasty were tense.

"I didn't expect that there are such strong people in the outside world. It seems that we have underestimated this world."

"Yes, this is the first time I have seen a super-god martial god."

"Hehe, let's take a look first. Lord Qin's strength is definitely not weak. It's a good opportunity to see how strong the so-called martial god is."

Inside the palace.

Yan Lingyun stood on the rooftop, looking at Jiang Bei in the void with a calm expression.

She naturally recognized Jiang Bei, who was a strong man under Lu Daosheng.

So she was not angry about Jiang Bei's unauthorized intrusion. Instead, she ordered not to conflict with him. She knew what Jiang Bei wanted.

Isn't it just to find a strong man to compete with?

What her Divine Dynasty lacked the most was strong men.

"Go, call back those who are fine, and tell them that someone is here."

"Yes, Your Majesty."

At this time, a thunderous roar was heard in the void.

Suddenly, a shadow began to retreat violently.

Wherever it passed, the space was completely shattered into nothingness, which shows the horror of power.

The commander of the Imperial Guard looked at Jiangbei in the distance with a serious expression.

Under the same realm, he couldn't even withstand the opponent's attack.

Is the God of War so terrifying?

That's right, after a blow, he retreated violently, and after a moment of silence, a unique power suddenly overflowed from his body.

In just a moment, his breath surged several times.

"Come again!"

The next moment, he rushed towards Jiangbei again.

Seeing this, Jiangbei shook his head slightly, and then stepped forward.

Bang!

Jiang Bei easily resolved the opponent's attack with a casual blow, and the next moment, a heavy punch hit the opponent's blind spot.

In the palace, Yan Lingyun looked at the fight in the void and shook her head slightly.

It was simply a one-sided beating.

Whether it was strength or fighting skills, Jiang Bei was suppressing Qin Teng in all aspects, and there was no possibility of winning.

In fact, Qin Teng himself also felt it deeply.

Facing Jiang Bei's attack, he really felt a strong sense of powerlessness.

With the last force rushing towards him, Qin Teng looked a little desperate.

Why is there such a big gap in the same realm.

Buzz——

At this moment, a light shield suddenly condensed in front of him, blocking Jiang Bei's last blow.

The next moment, the space cracked, and a woman holding an unknown staff appeared beside Qin Teng.

"Chief Qin, let me do it."

Looking at the panting Qin Teng, the woman smiled faintly.

Hearing this, Qin Teng smiled helplessly, "Be careful, this guy is really fierce."

The woman nodded and then walked towards Jiangbei in the distance.

"The third general of the Divine Dynasty, Mu Yu, please give me some advice."

Seeing this, Jiangbei smiled slightly.

"Desolate City, Jiangbei."
